conventions: Census refrain וְעִמּוֹ N הַזְּכָרִים → 'and with him N males': the ASV writes no copula and no the, so עִם takes bare 'with', the suffix 'him' (or 'them' at 8.14, aligned as written), the numeral its own word, and the article on הַזְּכָרִים is unrepresented under rule 29. The anarthrous לִזְכָרִים of 8.3 → 'of the males' is the one exception, לִ taking 'of' and the noun the supplied 'the'. Where the ASV does write a copula with עִם (8.33 'with him was Eleazar') it joins the preposition under rule 49; the refrain's bare 'with' is not a second treatment of the same construction.
report: Read all 36 verses end to end against the 51-lemma candidate table. Every multi-treatment bucket is licensed by the ASV's own wording, not a split: waw takes whichever connective the ASV wrote (And/Then/So/but/also/with) and is unrepresented only at 8.26 where the ASV opens 'I weighed' bare; the article on הַזְּכָרִים in the census refrain (vv.4-14) is unrepresented because the ASV writes bare 'males' throughout, while the anarthrous זְכָרִים of 8.3 takes the supplied 'the' of 'of the males'; לְ, עַל, מִן and בְּ each take the word written for them and go unrepresented only where the recasting leaves none (8.15 בָּעָם/בַכֹּהֲנִים promoted to direct objects, 8.18 dative 'brought us', 8.23 'besought our God', 8.26 לְכִכָּרִים, 8.34 לַכֹּל recast as subject).

Cross-verse constructions checked and found consistent: 'the son/sons of' with supplied the on the construct (all 33); compound numerals fused under rule 30 (8.9, 18, 24, 31, 35); לִפְנֵי fused as 'before' (8.21, 29); prepositional predicate takes the copula (8.22 עַל, 8.33 עִם) while the census refrain 'with him N males' writes no copula and עִם takes bare 'with'; anarthrous participles take supplied the/them that (8.22, 31); 'of fathers houses' on elliptical אָבוֹת (8.1, 29) versus 'of fathers' where the ASV supplies no noun (8.28); 8.31 'unto Jerusalem' and 8.32 'to Jerusalem' both on the accusative name under rule 33.

The seven added units are each defended and distinct: 8.1 'this' (second subject of a clause the ASV split, referent contested in the note), 8.17 italic 'and' before אָחִיו, 8.25 appositional 'even' with no marker on תְּרוּמַת, 8.29 two supplied objects 'them' and 8.30 one, 8.34 'and' for the asyndetic 'by number, by weight'. None is folded into a neighbour elsewhere in the chapter.

8.17 unit 15 (שׂים בְּפִי → 'told', three morphemes) is a genuine rule 40 fusion: 'told' carries verb, preposition and noun together and no word is spent on any one of them. 8.35 aligns שְׁבִי/גּוֹלָה by structure though the ASV's glosses are reversed; the note records it.

BSB disagreements are all convention: unrendered articles before bare English nouns (Td ×17), cohortative he (Sh ×9, rule 32), object markers (To ×4), prepositions silenced by recasting (R ×5, Rd ×3) and the one unrendered verse-initial waw at 8.26. No genuine error found.
No promotion or amendment: the chapter applies existing rules and teaches nothing general.
